Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
Uh... could you explain that again a bit more clearly? What you mean with cards purchased? Also adding card text of relevant cards helps a lot.

If you are asking whether you can use only cards from either ashheap OR hand though, then you can remove any combination from both.

Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
The doubt is if players can use cards that are replaced when play allies / retainer from hand to add life to Construction.

Eg.: Player A play Corruption Construction and remove from game 4 ally cards from hand to add life to Construction, replace this for 4 cards and play more 2 retainers from replaced cards, than play more 1 ally replaced from this last draw.

As a head judge in Brazilian Championship 2012 I search in old group and see some topics about that and based on it I say no, players can't use replaced cards to add life to Construction.

Fernando Cesar - Sydnelson
LackeyCCG and OCTGN VtES Mantainer

Prince of Rio de Janeiro

Powerbase Rio de Janeiro

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Ah, no you can't do that, you don't replace any of the cards until you have finished the effect of adding the life to it.
